in_hebrew.name: Vonnie
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Vonnie הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the Old French word 'vonnerie', meaning 'little stranger' or 'newcomer'. This name was often given to babies born outside of wedlock or to those who were adopted. In the context of Christianity, it can also symbolize the spiritual journey of a newborn soul.
